integrity: One analytic theorem and its direct planar-factor consequence; proof is supplied and a deterministic exact-arithmetic script performs supplementary finite checks. Independent validation has not been performed.
limitations: Applies only to nontrivial Cartesian decompositions and two test bodies. The values of higher-dimensional factor coefficients are not provided; unlocated equivalent earlier theorems remain possible.
title: Exact Cartesian-product law for the two-body Bézout mixed-volume coefficient
